curation.reason: Original MIT informational marks and reviewed source-based vehicle schematics; source flags are not current in-service proof. No photos, external SVGs or official logos copied.

features: Four long tapered R7-family side boosters around a narrow core
Representative satellite fairing; Fregat/Volga/2.1a/2.1b internal differences remain labelled and are not visible through fairing
coverage.limitations: Original simplified informational front view; not an engineering drawing or mission paint. Flat booster spread shows the total count. Payload/internal-stage differences remain in the exact configuration label; lifecycle is not inferred. Radial source-based projection replaces the former detached flattened booster spread.

facts.creator: SpaceFox contributors
facts.credit: Original SpaceFox informational schematic; no official logo endorsement

radialProjection.limitations: Representative short fairing estimated from the Roscosmos Volga launch photograph; launch provider quotes 46.3 m Soyuz/Fregat with an alternate fairing. Exact configuration and fairing length are not inferred from the stage label.
